import json
import os
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, 'ops/devlane/hooks/claude')
import matrix
cwd = os.getcwd()
rows = {
    "pgrep-read": "pgrep -af 'x/ops/devlane/dispatch/launch.py'",
    "grep-read": "grep launch.py README.md",
    "python-launch": "python3 ops/devlane/dispatch/launch.py",
    "direct-launch": "ops/devlane/dispatch/launch.py implement",
}
for name, command in rows.items():
    decision = matrix.decide({"tool_name": "Bash", "cwd": cwd, "tool_input": {"command": command}})
    print(name, "deny" if decision else "allow", json.dumps(decision, sort_keys=True) if decision else "")
PY
